If d is a distance on X such that: (iiim) d(x, y) = d(y, x), for all x, y ∈ X, then (X, d) is called a symmetric space and d is called a symmetric on X.

If d satisfies the condition (F) for any ε > 0 there exists δ = δ(ε) > 0 such that from d(x, y) ≤ δ and d(y, z) ≤ δ it follows d(x, z) ≤ ε, then d is called an F-distance or a Fréchet distance and (X, d) is called an F-distance space.
